text:
lina: Quick sync — product wants us to roll out a proto-first surface for the new typed API, but keep older clients functional. Thoughts on safe negotiation + rollout UX?

 tom: I think negotiation should be done at the edge. Client sends `Accept` (proto or json). Edge/middleware picks handler. Keep the actual business services unchanged for now.

 ari: Sidecar vs in-gateway? Sidecar adapter that speaks proto <-> json seems low risk for rollout. We can monitor and then move into gateway later if perf looks good.

 carlos: Agree with sidecar for initial run. Important: billing/quotas must be invariant. If proto messages are smaller we can't bill purely on bytes. Normalize on decoded request units at the runtime boundary. Router should attach `x-client-surface` and `x-transport` metadata.

 jess: For telemetry we need these signals: `router.transport.selected{transport=proto|json}`, `router.fallback.count{trigger=negotiation}`, and `router.transport.p50/p95.latency`. Also add `client_version` tag so Console can show which SDKs are still on json.

 lina: UX asks: Console slider to control percent of routed traffic to proto, plus a one-click rollback if error rate spikes. Can we reuse existing rollout infra?

 tom: Yes — reuse per-route weights. Add a simple slider UI that maps to the per-route weight override. Make sure it's auditable (who changed it + timestamp).

 rollout-bot: Warning: auto-rollbacks triggered on transient infra blips last quarter. Recommend guard: require both absolute error rate threshold AND a relative increase over baseline before automatic rollback.

 ari: Good call. Also add a short delay window (3 mins) to avoid flapping and require the condition to hold for N consecutive windows.

 carlos: Trace propagation/ids: adapter must preserve `x-request-id` and standard tracing headers (`traceparent`/`b3`). If adapter normalizes payloads, ensure we don't overwrite incoming trace ids.

 jess: For logs, keep structured fields: `negotiated_transport`, `fallback_reason`, `adapter_latency_ms`. These should be indexed for quick search.

 lina: Operational plan proposal: 1) spike sidecar + envoy route (dev cluster) for quick smoke tests; 2) enable canary 1% for internal clients; 3) expand to 10% with telemetry checks; 4) full rollout after 2 weeks stable.

 tom: Implementation detail: add header `X-RW-Proto-Canary: <client_id>` for deterministic bucketing. Gateway/sidecar reads it to decide routing.

 ari: I'll add metrics and a small Console preview showing: time-series of `transport split`, fallback %, and heatmap of client versions. Product can preview before we flip live.

 carlos: I'll draft quota normalization table mapping proto fields -> billing units and attach examples. Keep examples small.

 lina: Example curl matrix for QA (putting here for the spike PR):

 # proto preferred
 curl -H "Accept: application/x-protobuf" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-RW-Proto-Canary: client-abc" --data-binary @payload.pb https://edge.dev/api/v1/thing:mutate

 # json client (fallback)
 curl -H "Accept: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"foo":"bar"}' https://edge.dev/api/v1/thing/mutate

 jess: Nice. For dashboards I'll add a panel for `router.fallback.count` with drilldown to `fallback_reason`, and a transport latency panel split by transport.

 tom: Logging + metrics also power alerts. Proposed alert: if `router.fallback.count{reason=negotiation}` exceeds 5% of requests AND `router.errors.rate` > 0.5% for 5m, trigger on-call. Keep it conservative initially.

 rollout-bot: Note: include a manual “panic button” in Console that sets proto weight to 0 instantly for that route. That was requested by SRE.

 lina: Action items:
 - tom: design header negotiation and sidecar contract (PR by Tue).
 - ari: add metrics + Console mock (Wed).
 - carlos: quota normalization doc + examples (Thu).
 - jess: dashboard + alert drafts (Thu).
 - lina: write rollout runbook + rollback playbook (Fri).

 tom: ack. I'll include compatibility tests covering mixed client versions.

 carlos: small note: ensure the adapter returns `X-RW-Transport: proto|json` for downstream visibility.

 jess: and include a Grafana dashboard link in the spike PR so product can click through.

 lina: sounds like a plan. If we're all +1 I'll open the spike PR and schedule a 30m checkin after the initial dev cluster tests. :rocket: 

 ari: +1

 tom: +1

 carlos: +1

 jess: +1 :thumbsup:

 lina: I'll post PR link here when ready.
